lines.en: My wings are lime green.

lines.zh: 叶子上那点光，正好照着我。
lines.en: That patch of light on the leaf falls on me.

lines.zh: 我从一丛蕨飞到另一丛。
lines.en: I fly from one fern to the next.

lines.zh: 丛林里绿得发闷，我不显眼。
lines.en: The jungle is thick with green; I barely stand out.
A dark edge runs along my forewing.
The pattern on my wing looks like a saw's teeth.
I do not fly high; the wind worries me.
The canopy hides most of the sky.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶缘一圈一圈飞。
lines.en: I fly the leaf edges in circles.
The flowers are low; I descend.
A bird passes and I freeze.

lines.zh: 绿翅贴着绿叶，谁看得见。
lines.en: Green on green; who would see me.
My wingtip brushes against moss.

lines.zh: 藤上开着小白花，我绕过去。
lines.en: Little white flowers bloom on the vine; I go around.
Deeper in the wood the light breaks into pieces.

lines.zh: 我沿着同一条路线来回。
lines.en: I fly the same route back and forth.
I settle in the curl of a fern.

lines.zh: 翅上的黄绿在暗处发亮。
lines.en: The lime shines in the shade.
I spread my wings to the sun.
This flower has been drained.
I move elsewhere to wait.
Fine hairs coat the leaf veins.
I clean my antennae with a foreleg.
There is water somewhere in the wood.
I have not found it yet.
Pollen sticks to my wings.
Fine lime dust coats my wings.
An ant crosses the leaf.
Your clothes are grey.
You are not easy to see.
I land on your cuff.
That cloth is yellow.
Far brighter than my wings.
You look down to find me.
You barely noticed.
That is the advantage of green.
You are looking for something green.
I am right in front of you.
A piece of my wing is gone.
The lime has gone dull.
I rest on a leaf.
I keep tipping to one side.
I can last a while longer.
A split opens across the green wing.
I cling to the leaf's underside.
One gust and I will fall.
I grip the leaf vein tightly.
Just one more stretch of flight.
That flower is yellow.
I spotted it at once.
Let me go and take a sip.
Your hand is in the way.
Shift it to one side.
Not much nectar, but enough.
You picked a flower and will not share.
That one is yellow.
It does not match my wings.
A poppy's center — perfect to land on.
You knocked the dust off my wings.
There is a print on my wing now.
I fly a short distance away.
What shade of green is that on you?
It does not match mine.
I settle on your shoulder.
You swept the leaf and I nearly fell.
I grip the leaf stem hard.
The stem sways for a long while.
I wait for you to stop.
There is one other in this wood.
Its green leans a little yellow.
I am waiting for it to fly over.
Do not block the wind with your hand.
I waited half a day on this leaf.
Perhaps it took another route.
The wind comes from that side; good.
I will ride the wind there.
I may not find it.
Still, one has to try.
Something has fallen on the leaf.
Lime coloured, like scale dust.
I touch it once.
That thing is not mine.
I fly off.
There are other things on the leaf.
A scrap of wing membrane.
Yellow, not green.
Perhaps someone dropped it.
I moved a little away.
Your net is white.
It stands out against all this green.
I will not fly that way.
I drop under a leaf.
That white mass is moving this way.
I press myself to the leaf.
The underside is dark.
You may not find me.
Your hand comes in.
I go a little lower.
You circle in with the net raised.
I shift along the leaf's underside.
All you can see is green.
So I stop there.
Your net has touched the leaf.
I move behind the stem.
You switched hands.
I use the gap to fly up.
The shadow of your net comes down.
I slip out from underneath.
You pinch my wingtip.
Dust smears on your finger.
I struggle twice.
Green dust falls onto your palm.
Your fingers close and my wing crinkles.
My legs kick between your fingers.
Green dust smears everywhere.
You loosened your grip a little.
I pull free while I can.

lines.zh: 你指头一用力，我就完了。
lines.en: One squeeze of your fingers and I am done.
Dawn just broke and the leaves are damp.
I climb out beside the chrysalis shell.
My lime wings are still crumpled on my back.
Let me wait a moment.
An empty chrysalis hangs under the fern.
I open my wings beside it.
That lime green in the jungle is me.
The sun has only just reached the leaf tip.

lines.zh: 我翅上还带着蛹里的湿气。
lines.en: The damp of the chrysalis is still on my wings.
The dawn is just right, neither cold nor hot.
The heat comes and my wing edge scorches first.
I fall into the gap between ferns.
The surface holds me; I beat my wings.

lines.zh: 爆炸一响，黄绿的翅翻了
lines.en: The blast hits and my lime wings tumble.

lines.zh: 一颗小石打掉我一角翅膀。
lines.en: A pebble knocks a corner off my wing.

lines.zh: 光过来，我的翅就不听使唤。
lines.en: The light comes and my wings stop obeying.

lines.zh: 花都空了，我飞得越来越低。
lines.en: The flowers are empty; I fly lower and lower.

lines.zh: 那一下的光让我看不见叶子。
lines.en: The flash blinds me to the leaves.
All the green below is gone.
